source_principle: 同一餐厨起居区需要在日常用餐、待客和偶尔留宿之间转换时，可移动的桌子便于按活动腾出空间。
reconstruction_assumptions: Only the reported shared living/dining/kitchen activity area is represented; permanent bedroom, bathroom and corridor are outside this selected room. The full45m²home is not reconstructed.
The source supports a movable co-designed table and a convertible sofa. This static sofa has no conversion; a declared guest floor reserve is not evidence that anyone can sleep there.
All room/furniture dimensions, entrance/window positions and candidate movements are researcher assumptions. Source geometry/coordinates are unavailable.
Generated table wheels are visual meshes only; moving tools teleport poses. No physical pushing, swept articulation, braking or load claim.
Capacity, comfort, seating, kitchen services, privacy and professional quality remain unknown.
benefit: Declared guest reserve cleared in step8; all six fixed access points remain reachable under three square-body widths; all object IDs retained and everyday layout restored.
cost: Everyday dining placement is interrupted while guest reserve is active; chair staging changes use until return. Original staging candidate lost window access and was rejected pre-execution.
unknowns: Furniture inventory and declared reserve/points do not establish full human use.
